title: Paojiao134‘s Wanderer
description: Special mod for the gameplay of the "Wanderer" game
body:
✨ Features
❤️ Increased Max Health \
Sets the player's base maximum health to 40 HP (20 Hearts) by default. \
Survive longer against powerful mobs and environmental hazards. \
Configurable: You can adjust the exact amount of health in the config file (default: 40.0).

⛏️ Permanent Haste \
Grants the player a permanent Haste effect. \
Mine blocks faster immediately upon spawning—no Beacons required. \
No Particles: The effect is applied without screen-cluttering potion particles. \
Configurable: Adjust the Haste amplifier level (default: Level 2 / Haste III) or disable it entirely.

🔥 Smart Auto-Smelt \
Automatically smelts mined Ores和Raw Materials into their ingot forms. \
Examples: \
Iron Ore / Raw Iron ➔ Iron Ingot \
Gold Ore / Raw Gold ➔ Gold Ingot \
Ancient Debris ➔ Netherite Scrap \
Smart Filtering: This feature is strictly limited to ores and raw materials. Mining Logs will still drop logs (not Charcoal), and Sand will still drop sand (not Glass), ensuring your building materials remain safe.

⚙️ Configuration \
You can customize the mod via the wanderer-common.toml file located in your config folder. \
Recommended: Install the Configured mod to edit settings directly through the in-game Mod Menu! \
```toml
[Player Stats]
    # Enable or disable max health modification
    enableMaxHealthModify = true
    # Set the max health value (20.0 = 10 Hearts, 40.0 = 20 Hearts)
    maxHealthValue = 40.0

    # Enable or disable permanent haste
    enablePermanentHaste = true
    # Haste Amplifier (0 = Level I, 1 = Level II, 2 = Level III)
    hasteAmplifier = 2

[Mining]
    # Enable auto-smelting for ores and raw materials
    enableAutoSmelt = true
```

📥 Installation \
Download and install Minecraft Forge for 1.20.1. \
Place the Wanderer.jar file into your .minecraft/mods folder. \
(Optional) Install the Configured mod for in-game configuration menus. \
Launch the game and enjoy!
